list: the official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden
note: Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags are the official list as published on PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before launch. Counts are the numbers the PlayStation tracker reports for each trophy. Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; each one names the source its facts come from.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you earn, and the only one with no task of its own. It pops the moment the other 54 are all ticked off, so there is nothing extra to do for it: work through the roadmap in order — story, then robberies and side strands, then the collectibles and activities sweep, then the 100% checklist — and this one takes care of itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is the first thing you play. Finish it and the trophy pops. It is pure story progress, so it cannot be missed — just play.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Nothing optional is needed and nothing here can be missed — just play the story to the end of the chapter. Do keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, though: there is no mission replay, and the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude is only available during this chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story progress only — play the chapter's missions through to the end and the trophy pops. Chapter 2 is also where both characters become playable, which opens up the duo trophies and the meditation spots.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Another story-progress trophy: complete the chapter's missions and it pops on its own. GTA Zone places the Cartel Heist mission (Break the Bank) in this chapter, so expect a big set-piece on the way.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Play the chapter through to its final mission and the trophy pops. By now the open world is fully open, so this is a good point to start sweeping up the exploration and activity trophies between missions.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission — the story's last beat, and the only gold trophy in the story set. It pops at the end of the campaign. Keep a manual save from before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so that save is your only way back to the ending. After the credits you return to free roam and the 100% checklist unlocks.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as you play the story, so there is nothing to hunt for — take the mission when it appears and finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. GTA Zone places this heist in Chapter 3. It is a main-mission trophy, so it cannot be missed — play the mission when it appears and the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A main-mission trophy: it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Main-mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Main-mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends. The airport is also the setting of the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so keep an eye out while you are there.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Main-mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy on the list, and the last one most players earn before the platinum. The checklist only becomes visible after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls the requirements lenient — closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 collectible card sets and 15 of 18 meditation spots, plus the story, robberies and activities. GTABase splits the checklist into 45% story and tasks, 45% exploration and activities, and 10% discovery. Nothing on the checklist is missable: every requirement can still be finished in free roam after the credits, and you may skip the hardest challenges since only 70 of 80 are needed.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in the world, so you only need about two-thirds of them; the 100% checklist asks for 300. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime moments the game tracks as you drive and ride — chase the marked stunt jumps around Leonida and the counter climbs on its own. Nothing here is missable, so this is a cleanup-stage trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample one of each — a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, a drone race, a shooting range session and the rest — and the trophy pops. You do not need to win or finish anything, just try them all. This is the trophy that maps the activities for you: every type you sample here is one you will come back to for the other activity trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Every range challenge has a gold score to beat; work through them one weapon at a time and keep retrying — ranges can be replayed as often as you like, so nothing here is missable. Take your time and learn each challenge's target pattern before pushing for gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — all 14 of them. Learn each course's line before pushing for the win, and retry as often as you like; drone races can be replayed, so nothing is missable. The 100% checklist also needs every drone race, so this doubles up with A Long Road.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — street, off-road, boat or air — so spread your wins across race types instead of replaying one favourite. Replaying the same race does not add to the count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take Cal up on a fishing challenge and out-fish him; the trophy pops when you win the head-to-head. Fishing challenges can be retried, so keep at it until you beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and see it through to the end — any game counts, and you do not need a high score. One of the quickest trophies on the list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand of his own; work through his missions as they appear and finish the last one. Side-character strands are not story missions, so do them when they show up rather than leaving them all for the end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's mission strand as it appears and finish his last mission. Like the other side-character finals, it cannot be missed while the strand is available — take the missions when they show up.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work through Billy's mission strand as it appears and finish his last mission. Take side-character missions when they show up rather than leaving them for the end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions are marked on the map as you explore; finish 8 full strands, not just one mission each. PowerPyx's roadmap puts these in the post-story cleanup stage, but any strand you finish during the story already counts, so start them whenever you pass one.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's mission strand as it appears and finish his last mission. Randy's deliveries also count toward the 100 optional tasks on the 100% checklist, so his strand does double duty.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's mission strand as it appears and finish his last mission. Tyrone's lab work also counts toward the 100 optional tasks on the 100% checklist, so his strand does double duty.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice, so bring your partner along. Spots are marked with a purple icon on the map when you go near them, and progress is tracked under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: PowerPyx flags the first meditation — Lucia meditating on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, when she says she is going to meditate and you follow her and accept — as missable. It becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, since it is not marked as a spot like the rest. Do it the moment it is offered, and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this does not block 100% either way.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at a one-of-a-kind animal; track it down and take it down, and the trophy pops. Studying animals through the binoculars also counts toward the 100 animals the 100% checklist asks for, so keep the binoculars handy on the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 480 cards across 18 sets hidden around Leonida, so finishing any 3 sets is enough for the trophy — the 100% checklist asks for 15 of 18 sets, which is a much longer grind. Cards turn up while exploring and while WAiNK-ing points of interest, so pick up every card you pass and the sets will start completing on their own.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the phone's scan tool: point it at landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — PowerPyx lists 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures among the scan types — and scan 100 spots across Leonida. The 100% checklist asks for the same 100 locations, so this doubles up with A Long Road. Scan everything you pass while travelling and the counter climbs without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are split into 8 categories of 10 — 80 in total — and you only need 50 for the trophy, while the 100% checklist asks for 70. Pick the categories that suit how you play and skip the hardest ones; there is no penalty for leaving a category unfinished.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build up to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search cone until the wanted level clears. A fast car, the back roads and a good hiding spot beat trying to outrun the helicopters in a straight line.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner alongside, keeping the wanted level alive between robberies — the trick is the opposite of a normal escape: stay wanted, but not caught. Plan a route of three nearby shops and keep a fast getaway car idling outside each one.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game logs each new vehicle model you drive; 100 of the 277 base models is the target, and the 100% checklist asks for 200. Hop into everything you see while exploring — a new model counts the moment you get in — and this finishes long before the 200 you need for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight where enemies cluster and drop five before it ends. Pick a spot with plenty of cover and a group of enemies close together — a gang hideout or a robbery gone loud — and make every shot count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. The trophy's wording is the hint: get to the airport and leave by a route no schedule ever planned, by air. The exact trigger was still being pinned down by players at launch, so try the obvious thing — take a plane out of the airport without following the booked route — and it should pop.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks: get into a scrap with one and come out on top. The description is the whole hint and the exact trigger was unconfirmed at launch — the name suggests surviving or beating a Rhino encounter, so pick a fight with a tank and see it through.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and get out before anyone raises the alarm — no cameras tripped, no witnesses, no wanted level on the way out. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a failed attempt costs you nothing but time.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault jobs, each ending with a clean escape. Vaults are the big robbery set-pieces — PowerPyx's roadmap puts them in the post-story stage — so plan the exit before you go in, and keep a getaway car ready. The 100% checklist also needs every robbery, so this doubles up with A Long Road.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck on the road, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat. Trucks run set routes around Leonida, so wait for one on a quiet stretch where you can block the road and make a fast exit.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area of the map — the tracker counts 52 areas, from Vice City and the Leonida Keys to the Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. The map fills in as you travel, so this finishes naturally if you drive everywhere instead of fast-travelling, and it pairs well with the vehicle and WAiNK sweeps.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs in Leonida; hit one illegal operation for each of them. Operations are marked on the map once you find them, so work through the gangs one at a time and tick them off as you go.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view from the beachfront. Honest note: Output Lag lists this among the five trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch — the description is the only hint, so try the beachfront bars and let the trophy pop when it pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Find a vehicle showroom, get inside, and drive out through the glass in the most dramatic way possible — the name is a nod to the classic GTA showroom smash. Honest note: Output Lag lists this among the five trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch, so the exact trigger is still being pinned down; the description is the best guide there is.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and play a frame — the trophy is about showing up and following through, not about the score. A nod to the classic GTA IV bowling date, and one of the quickest trophies once you find the alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is the only hint and the exact trigger was unconfirmed at launch — it reads like a duo moment with your partner that lands with an audience. Try partner activities and public moments with Jason and Lucia together; the trophy will pop when you hit the right one.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The tracker counts choices up to 500. Play through the story making choices whenever the game offers them — this one accumulates as you play, so there is nothing to grind and nothing to miss. It is a slow-burn trophy that pops somewhere in the back half of the run.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The name says it: fail at something, then succeed on the second try. Honest note: Output Lag lists this among the five trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch — the likely reading is a retry that works, so keep playing normally and it should pop on a second attempt somewhere along the way.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — an odd sight, a weird encounter, the kind of thing you stumble on while exploring. Honest note: Output Lag lists this among the five trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch. Explore the stranger corners of the map — the swamps, the Keys, the back roads at night — and this one finds you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by, but with a bat or another melee weapon instead of a gun. Honest note: Output Lag lists this among the five trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch, so the exact trigger is still being pinned down; a melee hit from a slow-moving car is the best reading of the description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Keep robbing and laundering — the counter climbs with every job, and the vaults, trucks and gang operations in Stage 2 are the fastest way to fill it.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, ammo and anything else across the shops of Leonida; every dollar counts toward the $100,000. This finishes on its own if you spend normally through the run — and if you are short at the end, ammo and clothes are the fastest way to close the gap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them across Leonida. Each garage is also somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good, so buy them as you find them rather than leaving all 8 for the end. They are not cheap, so this one pairs with the money you make from the robbery stage.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the phone and register 10 different vehicles you own or find. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good: every new vehicle you discover is one you can register here too.

roadmap.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale
roadmap.summary: Finish the campaign. Every story trophy pops as you play, and the duo and exploration trophies start here too. Do the Chapter 1 meditation the moment it is offered — it is the one possibly missable trophy on the list.

roadmap.title: Robberies and side strands
roadmap.summary: Vaults, trucks, jewelry stores and gang operations, plus the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. Launder the marked bills as you go.

roadmap.title: Activities and collectibles sweep
roadmap.summary: Shooting ranges, drone races, races, stunts, challenges, cards, WAiNK scans, meditation spots, vehicles and the whole map. Most of these overlap with the 100% checklist, so do them together.

roadmap.title: 100% completion and the platinum
roadmap.summary: After the credits the checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Clear the remaining checklist rows — 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges — and A Long Road pops, then the platinum.

notes.online: No online trophies: all 55 are single-player, and the game launches without a new GTA Online mode.
notes.cheats: Turning on a cheat disables trophies, and you cannot save once one is used. Cheats only unlock after the story.
notes.saves: There is no mission replay and no New Game+. Keep manual saves at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
notes.time: PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 at about 200 hours; the story alone takes about 60 to 80 hours.
